note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God, the spirit and the voice of verses 15 to 17, and the angels are not pictured; Job and Eliphaz are not portrayed as biblical people but shown through ordinary people of today, and nothing violent is shown.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21 after the sentence-by-sentence pictures did not connect: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures. What he said went wrong before: he could not tell why some pictures were there, could not connect them to the meaning, and some were too abstract.

sections.meaning: Eliphaz reminds Job that he has steadied many who were falling, yet now that trouble has reached him, he is the one who gives way.
ideas: On a steep mountain trail a grey-haired man grips the forearms of a younger hiker whose knees are buckling, holding him up
On stone steps in a town a grey-haired man pulls a stumbling young man up onto his feet by both hands
A grey-haired man at a table teaches a circle of younger people who lean in to listen
A grey-haired man's hands steady a wobbling child on a bicycle
The same grey-haired man sits slumped on the stone steps with his head in his hands while a friend leans over him, talking
Alone at a kitchen table at night, a grey-haired man sits with his head in his hands
A lifeguard who has pulled many out of the sea sits exhausted on the sand, unable to get up
A strong porch post that held up the roof has cracked and buckled
A walking stick that others leaned on lies broken on the path
A doctor sits in a hospital waiting room, now waiting as family of a patient

sections.meaning: Eliphaz holds that people reap what they sow: the innocent are not wiped out, those who plant trouble harvest trouble, and even the fiercest are broken.
ideas: At harvest a farmer stands in his own plowed field that has grown nothing but thistles and thorns, an armful of them in his arms
Close view of a man's scratched hands gathering a harvest of thorny thistles into a basket
A golden wheat field beside a field choked with thorns, the line between them sharp
A hand scatters seeds that are thorny burrs over plowed ground
A hot dry wind bends a field of withered stalks under a white sky
An old gaunt lion lies alone in dry grass, too weak to hunt, while its cubs wander off far apart across the plain
An old lion with a thin mane lies with its head on its paws beside a dried-up water hole
Lion cubs wander alone in different directions across an empty plain
A boomerang curving back toward the one who threw it
A man pulling weeds from a garden he let go to ruin

sections.meaning: In the dead of night something unseen passed before Eliphaz; dread seized him, and in the hush a voice spoke.
ideas: A man lies rigid in bed in a dark room, eyes wide open, his face lit by a thin line of moonlight, listening
A man sits on the edge of his bed in the dark, gripping the mattress, staring into the dark, trembling
A man sits bolt upright in bed in fear as the curtains billow into the dark room and the candle flame is blown flat
Close view of a forearm in moonlight with every hair standing on end, a curtain stirring behind
A candle flame in a dark room bent flat by a breath of air
A man's ear on a pillow in darkness, as if hearing a whisper
A dark hallway with a pale shapeless glow at its end
A curtain blown in by the night wind beside an empty chair
A man at a dark window gripping the sill
A sleeping house at night with one window lit

sections.meaning: The voice says no mortal is pure before God: people are fragile as clay houses on dust, crushed as easily as a moth, gone between morning and evening without anyone noticing, their tent pulled down.
ideas: A lone man stands on a hilltop at night, tiny beneath an immense sky blazing with stars
A man holds a freshly washed white shirt up to the blazing midday sun, and in that light faint stains show
A small house of sun-dried clay on bare dusty ground, its walls cracked and crumbling
A pale moth rests on an old man's open, wrinkled palm
A clay pot lies shattered on a city pavement while a crowd hurries past without looking
A flower open in the morning lies wilted on a busy sidewalk by evening
At dusk on an empty plain a small canvas tent sags and falls as its cord comes loose and its stake lies pulled from the ground
A sandcastle melting as the tide comes in
An empty park bench with a hat left on it as people pass by
A moth beating at a lamp at night

scenes.principle: You have strengthened weak hands and made buckling knees firm.
scenes.shows: On old stone steps a strong grey-haired man pulls a stumbling young man up onto his feet by both hands.
scenes.prompt: On wide old stone steps in a quiet town square in bright daylight, a strong grey-haired man in a plain shirt firmly pulls a stumbling young man up onto his feet by both hands. The young man's knees are bent and unsteady; the older man is solid and calm. Trees and houses behind them.

scenes.principle: But now trouble has come to you, and you are the one who gives way.
scenes.shows: The grey-haired man sits slumped on the same stone steps with his head in his hands while an older friend leans over him, talking.
scenes.prompt: On wide old stone steps in a quiet town square in grey overcast daylight, a grey-haired man in a plain shirt sits slumped on a step with his head in his hands, worn out and shaken. A well-dressed older friend stands beside him and leans down toward him, one hand raised as he talks to him. Trees and houses behind them.

scenes.principle: Those who plow harm and sow misery harvest it.
scenes.shows: A farmer stands in his own field that has grown nothing but thistles and thorns, an armful of them in his arms, while the fields beyond are golden with wheat.
scenes.prompt: At harvest time under a pale hazy sky, a farmer stands in the middle of his own plowed field, but the whole field has grown up into nothing but thistles, thorns and briars. He holds an armful of thorny thistles he has just cut, and looks down at them. The neighbouring fields beyond the fence are golden with wheat.

scenes.principle: Even the fierce lion perishes for lack of prey, and its cubs are scattered.
scenes.shows: An old lion lies spent in the dry grass of an empty plain while three cubs wander off far apart.
scenes.prompt: On a dry African plain under a hot white sky, an old gaunt lion with a thin ragged mane lies alone in the dry grass, too weak to hunt, his ribs showing. Far off across the plain, three lion cubs are wandering away from him in different directions, each on its own. No other animals and no prey anywhere.

scenes.principle: A word came by stealth in the night, and dread came over him.
scenes.shows: A man lies rigid in bed in the dark, eyes wide open, listening, a line of moonlight across his face.
scenes.prompt: Late at night in a dark bedroom, a middle-aged man lies rigid on his back in bed with the sheet pulled up to his chest, his eyes wide open, listening. A thin line of blue moonlight from the window falls across his face. The room is deep in shadow and very still.

scenes.principle: Something passed before his face and the hair of his flesh bristled.
scenes.shows: A man sits bolt upright in bed in fear as the curtains billow into the dark room and the candle flame is blown flat.
scenes.prompt: Late at night in a dark bedroom, a middle-aged man sits bolt upright in bed, wide-eyed with fear, clutching the sheet. A sudden breath of wind sweeps through the room: the long pale curtains billow far into the room and the flame of a candle on the bedside table is blown flat sideways. Cold blue moonlight. Nothing else is in the room.

scenes.principle: Can a man be clean before his maker?
scenes.shows: A man holds a freshly washed white shirt up to the blazing sun, and in that light stains show through it.
scenes.prompt: Outdoors at blazing midday, a man holds up a freshly washed white shirt at arm's length toward the brilliant sun to look at it. In that intense light, faint grey stains that cannot be seen otherwise show through the white cloth. A washing line and a clear blue sky behind.

scenes.principle: People live in houses of clay with their foundation in the dust, crushed sooner than a moth.
scenes.shows: A small house of sun-dried clay on bare dusty ground, its walls cracked and crumbling, a moth resting on it.
scenes.prompt: A small, simple house built of sun-dried clay stands alone on bare, dusty ground under harsh light. Its walls are cracked from top to bottom and crumbling, and pieces of dry clay have fallen into the dust at its foot. A pale moth rests on its wall.

scenes.principle: From morning to evening they are gone; their tent cord is pulled up and they die.
scenes.shows: At dusk on an empty plain an old canvas tent sags and collapses, its cord loose and its stake pulled up out of the ground.
scenes.prompt: At dusk on a wide, empty plain under a deep blue evening sky, a small old canvas tent is sagging and folding in on itself: its main cord has come loose and its stake lies pulled up out of the ground beside it, and the tent is collapsing. Soft evening light.
